name: red slope 3x4
where: the red 3x4 slope brick, sloped face up, against the left edge of the plate, a little below the middle of the plate's height
checks: the brick touches the left edge of the plate
it is red
it sits roughly at mid-height of the plate, not near the top or bottom edge

name: purple 2x4 cab
where: the purple 2x4 brick standing upright (2 wide, 4 tall), directly to the right of the red slope and touching it; its bottom is level with the red brick's bottom and its top sticks up one stud above the red brick's top
checks: the purple brick touches the right side of the red slope
its bottom edge is level with the red brick's bottom edge
it is taller than the red brick by one stud at the top

name: green 1x2 exhaust
where: the small lime-green 1x2 brick standing upright (1 wide, 2 tall), immediately to the right of the purple brick at its top corner, sticking up one stud above the purple brick like an exhaust pipe
checks: the lime brick touches the right side of the purple brick
it is vertical (taller than wide)
its top is one stud higher than the purple brick's top

name: white 1x6 top
where: the first white 1x6 brick lying flat, directly to the right of the purple brick with its left end touching the purple brick, just under the lime exhaust (the exhaust sits on top of its left end)
checks: the brick is pure white, not beige or cream
it is horizontal, 6 studs long
its left end touches the purple brick
the lime exhaust stands directly above its left end

name: white 1x6 middle
where: the second white 1x6 brick lying flat directly under the first white brick, same length, left end touching the purple brick, both ends lined up with the brick above
checks: the brick is pure white like the one above it
it sits directly under the first white brick with no gap
its left end touches the purple brick
its right end lines up with the right end of the brick above

name: blue 1x4 lower-left
where: the blue 1x4 brick lying flat directly under the lower white brick, its left end touching the purple brick, its right end stopping two studs short of the white bricks' right end; its bottom is level with the bottom of the red and purple bricks
checks: the blue brick's left end touches the purple brick
it sits directly under the lower white brick with no gap
its right end is two studs short of the white bricks' right end
its bottom edge is level with the red and purple bricks' bottom edge

name: green 1x2 lower-right
where: the lime-green 1x2 brick lying flat to the right of the blue brick and touching it, filling the row so that its right end lines up with the white bricks' right end
checks: the lime brick touches the right end of the blue brick
it is horizontal, in the same row as the blue brick
its right end lines up with the right end of the white bricks above

name: white 1x4 tail door
where: the white 1x4 brick standing upright (1 wide, 4 tall) against the right end of the body, touching the ends of the two white bricks and the lime brick, like a tail door; its top is one stud above the top white brick and its bottom is level with the body's bottom
checks: the brick is vertical (taller than wide), not lying flat
it touches the right ends of the white bricks and the lime brick
its top is one stud higher than the top white brick
its bottom is level with the bottom of the body

name: red disc front wheel
where: the red round disc (4 studs across) directly under the red slope, touching its bottom edge, same width as the slope, against the left edge of the plate, like a front wheel
checks: the disc touches the bottom edge of the red slope
it is as wide as the red slope and lined up with it
it touches the left edge of the plate

name: red disc rear wheel
where: the second red round disc directly under the right half of the body, as the rear wheel: its right edge is one stud column left of the tail door, its top touches the bottom of the body (the blue and lime bricks), and three empty stud columns separate it from the front disc
checks: the disc's top touches the bottom of the body
its right edge is one stud to the left of the tail door, not under it
there are about three empty stud columns between the two discs
it is not under the purple cab or the red slope

name: tan 1x6 ground left
where: the tan (beige) 1x6 brick lying flat directly under the front disc, its left end at the left edge of the plate, like the ground line
checks: the brick is beige/tan, not white
it is horizontal and lies directly under the front disc
its left end is at the left edge of the plate

name: white 1x6 ground mid
where: the white 1x6 brick lying flat in the same row as the tan brick, continuing it to the right and touching it, running under the rear disc
checks: the brick is pure white
it is in the same row as the tan brick and touches its right end
it runs under the rear disc

name: yellow 1x4 ground right
where: the yellow 1x4 brick lying flat in the same row, continuing the white ground brick to the right and touching it, ending at the right edge of the plate under the tail door
checks: the brick is yellow
it is in the same row as the white ground brick and touches its right end
its right end is at the right edge of the plate
